title: Break, and a recap of schooling for drums and football
summary: The recording pauses and Crouch returns to what Crawford said the previous night about school.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers

blocks.x: Oh, now you -- before you -- last night when I didn't have the tape off -- on --

-- you were speaking of your -- at one point you were speaking of your education as a drummer. And you said, when you went to school, you didn't go to -- you said last night -- you said you only went to school for two things. What were the two?
Well, to play. That's all I thought
school was for, schools were for, and to play my drums and football. But when we left Lakeside, Ohio -- are you taping?
